author: pdusen
changelog:
This release replaces v0.9.1, whose download was pulled because it contained files from an unfinished development version of the mod. It ships v0.9.1's fixes (visitors that stopped coming, and Miraak's cultists leading nearly every ambush) in a clean package.

## Fixes

- The v0.9.1 download mixed in parts of an unfinished, in-development version of the mod. That could leave the dashboard showing raw labels like `TAB.DIRECTOR`, make tabs disappear when clicked, or show the dashboard in another language, and some prompts and settings were also from the unfinished version. v0.9.2 is built cleanly and contains only this release's files.

## Notes

> **If you installed v0.9.1:** replace it rather than installing over it. In MO2, choose "Replace" (not "Merge") when installing v0.9.2, or uninstall v0.9.1 first; for a manual install, delete v0.9.1's files before copying v0.9.2 in. Otherwise v0.9.1's extra language and prompt files stay behind.
